text:
Alex: Quick question — I'm about to apply a terraform change that updates a shared ConfigMap for per-model runtime knobs. Will that trigger rolling restarts for all model pods? Trying to avoid a full rollout.
Maria: If you update the ConfigMap resource itself, kube won't restart pods automatically. We rely on the checksum annotation pattern on the Deployment podTemplate: `checksum/config: <sha256>` so Helm/TF can force a new podSpec and trigger a rolling update.
Kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342 — adds an external data source that computes SHA256 of files and injects it into `helm_release` values.
Alex: So terraform computes the hash and we pass it to Helm values which ends up in the pod annotation?
Maria: Exactly. Flow is: terraform reads config files -> computes sha256 -> sets `values.config.checksum` on `helm_release` -> helm template includes `annotations: {"checksum/config": "{{ .Values.config.checksum }}"}` under `spec.template.metadata` -> K8s sees changed podTemplate -> rolling update.
Sam: Note the per-model configs live in a separate ConfigMap mounted at `/etc/model-configs`. If you only change that CM and don't change the podTemplate annotation, pods won't restart. Options: add per-model checksum, or run a config-reloader sidecar.
Alex: Do we have a sidecar we can reuse for hot reload?
Jess: There's `config-reloader` in eng-runtime (small watcher that emits SIGHUP to the main process). It's not wired for model containers by default. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/eng-runtime/config-reloader.
Maria: For safety I'd prefer checksum + canary rollout. Compute composite checksum of global + per-model entries you intend to change, pass it to helm, and limit the rollout with `maxSurge/maxUnavailable` or use a label-based canary Deployment.
Kevin: Also FYI about secrets: if these knobs move from ConfigMap -> secret (KMS wrapped), ensure terraform creates the `kubernetes_secret` before `helm_release` (use `depends_on`) and that the secret name is stable. Otherwise Helm may see diff and recreate resources unexpectedly.
Alex: Good catch. I'll update the PR to: (1) compute composite checksum, (2) add `depends_on` for secret creation, (3) add a helm value toggle to enable canary via labels.
Kevin: Quick lint note — use lowercase `checksum/config` key to avoid template issues with some tooling.
Alex: Roger. Ping me if CI or apply fails. @DeployBot can you post when the dev cluster apply completes?
DeployBot: apply started for infra/prs/342 on cluster dev — plan ok, applying...
DeployBot: apply complete — 3 resources changed, `helm_release` upgraded, rolling update initiated for `deployments/model-*` :rocket:
Sam: Watching logs — new pods came up fine, old pods drained gracefully, no config loader errors.
Alex: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
